attchmntText: INDO-MIM Limited has informed the Exchange about the Intimation under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations )   Audio Recording of Earnings Conference Call held on November 16, 2026 at 15:00 HRS (IST) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Indo-MIM Limited has filed an intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations regarding the audio recording of an earnings conference call. The call was held on November 16, 2026, at 15:00 HRS IST. It discussed the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The audio link is available on the company website. This filing follows a previous notice dated November 11, 2026. The announcement was signed by Santosh Kumar Dash, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: INDO-MIM Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet and Presentation
voiceSummary: Indo-Mim Limited announced its half-year earnings review for the period ended 30 September 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations rose 11.8% year-on-year to Rs. 2,490.6 crore. Profit after tax increased 57.0% to Rs. 455.3 crore. EBITDA margin expanded by approximately 630 basis points to 32.0%. Basic earnings per share grew to Rs. 9.34 from Rs. 6.02. The company reported a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.27x, down from 0.50x in the previous year. Management stated a normalised EBITDA margin range of 20% to 25% and a PAT margin range of 13% to 18%. Full-year revenue targets for FY27 are set at Rs. 5,000 crore with a bottom line target of Rs. 850 crore. Additionally, the company intimated its schedule for analyst and institutional investor meetings in November 2026.

attchmntText: INDO-MIM Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Indo-MIM Limited submitted its investor presentation for the half-year ended September 30, 2026, following an earnings conference call on November 16, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations rose 11.8% year-on-year to Rs. 2,490.6 crore. Profit after tax increased 57.0% to Rs. 455.3 crore. EBITDA margin expanded to 32.0%, up 630 basis points. Standalone revenue grew 7.5% to Rs. 2,073.1 crore, with standalone profit after tax up 51.7% to Rs. 443.5 crore. Return on capital employed improved to 36.5%. Debt-to-equity ratio decreased to 0.27x. Management stated a normalised EBITDA margin range of 20% to 25% and a PAT margin range of 13% to 18%. Full-year revenue targets for FY27 are set at Rs. 5,000 crore, with a bottom-line target of Rs. 850 crore.

attchmntText: INDO-MIM Limited has informed the Exchange about the Submission of copy of Newspaper Advertisement published on November 15, 2026 pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.
voiceSummary: Indo-Mim Limited has submitted a copy of a newspaper advertisement published on November 15, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a meeting held on November 13, 2026. The advertisement was published in the Financial Express and Hosa Digantha newspapers. This submission is pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company requests the exchange to take the submission on record.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Indo-MIM Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, received from CARE Ratings Limited on November 13, 2026. The report covers the utilization of Rs. 500 crore raised through the Initial Public Offer. No deviation from the objects was reported. Rs. 400 crore was fully utilized for repayment of outstanding borrowings. Rs. 75.90 crore was utilized for general corporate purposes, including customs duty payments of Rs. 2.90 crore, advance tax payments of Rs. 20.00 crore, and vendor payments of Rs. 53.00 crore. Rs. 14.56 crore remains unutilized for issue expenses. The total unutilized amount stands at Rs. 24.10 crore. The company routed funds through current accounts, resulting in comingling of funds. CARE Ratings relied on supporting bank statements and email confirmations for verification.

attchmntText: INDO-MIM Limited has informed the Exchange about the Proposal to make investment in Meena Solar Power Park Private Limited to acquire 6.5% equity stake under group captive scheme.
voiceSummary: INDO-MIM Limited approved its Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved an investment proposal to subscribe to equity shares of M/s. Meena Solar Power Park Private Limited. The investment amount will not exceed Rs. 97,500, representing 6.5% of the Target Company's share capital. The Company will enter into a Power Purchase Agreement and a Share Purchase Agreement to purchase electricity under the Group Captive Scheme. The Company will update the Stock Exchange upon execution of these agreements. The Board meeting commenced at 07:00 P.M. and concluded at 08:00 P.M. on November 13, 2026.
